content:
I've been critical of Shopify. Publicly. Often. Not because it's bad - it's excellent for what it was built for. DTC brands. Entrepreneurs. Speed to market. But enterprise complexity and B2B? Different conversation. Different platforms.

In this issue

  • 1. Sidekick Went From Assistant to Builder. Sidekick does more than answer questions now.
  • 2. Your Products Now Talk to AI Agents. Shopify launched Agentic Storefronts. Your products become discoverable in ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity.
  • 3. Native A/B Testing Finally Arrived. For years, merchants needed third-party apps to test anything meaningful.
  • 4. The Product Network Creates an Internal Affiliate System. This one flew under the radar. Shopify Product Network lets merchants surface complementary products from other Shopify brands.
  • 5. POS Hub Signals Retail Commitment. New hardware might not sound exciting, but POS Hub tells a story.
  • 6. Developer Tools for the Agent Economy. Catalog API gives developers access to billions of products.
  • 7. The Real Surprise - B2B Got Serious. Here's where my assumptions fell apart.
